theory_title: Value Is Based On Future Cash
theory_content: DCF estimates the present value of expected future cash flows using a discount rate. It is sensitive to growth assumptions and the terminal value used.
Comparable valuation uses ratios like P/E, EV/EBITDA, and price-to-sales relative to similar companies. It is quick, but only useful when peer selection is appropriate.
Scenario analysis tests how valuation changes under bullish, base, and bearish assumptions. It helps investors avoid false certainty from a single forecast.
